evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the picker outline
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the picker outline" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the picker outline
sections.description: Color of the outline around the picker container (default light gray, #E0E0E0). Use a light neutral for a subtle card edge, or your accent color to make the picker stand out on the screen. It only shows when the border thickness above is greater than 0.
